title: A limb meets soil
hook: A limb shape can suit a particular task.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The broad forelimb and claws meet the soil in the schematic. Many moles have powerful forelimbs adapted for digging, though limb proportions differ across species. This picture does not measure digging force.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: Which forelimb feature is useful in this mole-digging sketch?
